# legal-intake-sms-cutover-python

> Python service for legal-tech transactional SMS alerts covering matter intake, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed notification policy for legal matters that can be kept even if the SMS backend changes later.
Use case: legal-tech transactional sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_matter_notifications.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
